name: ado-gateway
title: ADO Gateway
summary: Read and safely write selected Azure DevOps work items and PR artifacts with deterministic dry-run, approval, and validation gates.

use_when: Fetching Azure DevOps backlog items or work items
Fetching Azure DevOps pull request comments from a URL or explicit identifiers
Parsing Azure DevOps pull request URLs into concrete identifiers
Normalizing Azure DevOps data for another skill
Creating Azure DevOps work items with explicit approval
Creating Azure DevOps work item comments with explicit approval
Creating Azure DevOps pull requests with explicit approval
Creating or replying to Azure DevOps pull request comments with explicit approval
avoid_when: The task requires deleting Azure DevOps data
The task requires completing, abandoning, approving, or rejecting a pull request
The task is a GitHub pull request review
The task is generating or validating an OpenSpec file
The task is generic REST API work with no Azure DevOps context
